## Updated: List of Dark Net Markets (Tor & I2P)

Posted by: [DeepDotWeb](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/https://www.deepdotweb.com/author/admin/) October 28, 2013 in [Featured](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/https://www.deepdotweb.com/category/deepdot-news/), [News Updates](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/https://www.deepdotweb.com/category/news-updates/) [217 Comments](https://gwern.net/doc/darknet-market/2019-04-22-deepdotweb-dnmlist.html#comments)

**Last update:** 22.4.19  
**Listing:** ~19 Live Markets & Vendor Shops!  
See the most recent changes in the [Changelog](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/http://www.deepdotweb.com/hidden-marketplace-list-changelog/)

Welcome to our [Updated List of Dark Net Markets!](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/http://www.deepdotweb.com/2013/10/28/updated-llist-of-hidden-marketplaces-tor-i2p/) Can our list be Improved? Found any broken links? Let us know in the comments!

-   The list is **always** free of phishing links!
-   Check out these [Best Bitcoin Casinos!](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/https://bitcoincasinos.reviews/)
-   Every link is checked, browsed, registered and manually logged to verify its authenticity. Please double check if you are unsure of a link’s validity.
-   Links in the comments are NOT verified in any way.
-   Don’t be lazy! Do your research before using any dark net market. Check out the markets forum, the market sub-reddit, and be sure to look for information at:  
    **– [Our DarkNet Markets Comparison Chart](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/http://www.deepdotweb.com/dark-net-market-comparison-chart/)**  
    **– [Dread](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/https://www.deepdotweb.com/marketplace-directory/listing/dread/) or [DNMAvengers](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/https://www.deepdotweb.com/marketplace-directory/listing/darknet-avengers-dnmavengers/) forums.**
-   Use your common sense and consider every market as a potential scam. NEVER store coins on the sites; do not trust on-site escrows and always [Use PGP](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/http://www.deepdotweb.com/2013/11/11/pgp-tutorial-for-newbs-gpg4win/)!!!
-   Read and understand: [Market & Vendor Shops Listing Rules](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/https://www.deepdotweb.com/rules-for-market-vendor-shops-listing/), [Rules for Posting Market Reviews](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/https://www.deepdotweb.com/rules-for-posting-market-reviews/).

**PRIVACY TIP FOR DEEP WEB USERS**: Use a [VPN](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/https://www.deepdotweb.com/vpn-comparison-chart/) with Tor. Don’t fall into a false sense of security by believing that Tor is enough to protect you. If you want the very best anonymity and privacy while on the Deep Web then you need to be using a VPN with Tor. It is an extremely valuable tool in your fight for anonymity. [Click here to find the best VPN for privacy on the Deep Web](https://web.archive.org/web/20190424033315/https://www.deepdotweb.com/vpn-comparison-chart/).
